note: On a wooded ridge above the north shore of Lake Red Rock, Iowa's largest lake. This entry is the non-equestrian campground; the park's equestrian campground, horse stalls and riding arena are separate, and 13 miles of multi-use trail start there. The modern restrooms and showers close for the season from mid-October to mid-April. --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees (DNR sheet: $12/$16 non-electric, $20/$24 electric), showers, dump, ReserveAmerica. Filled sites: 29 in the non-equestrian campground (20 electric, 9 with 50A; 9 non-electric), 80-ft max, pull-throughs. Not waterfront confirmed (130 m+ of dense woods to the lake; no water in site photos). Pin ~870 m off; corrected.
flags: PIN (~870 m off): stored 41.40120,-93.08220 is east of the campground. The 29 RA site points of the non-equestrian campground centre on 41.40203,-93.09264 (range 41.40066-41.40321, -93.09419 to -93.09166). Proposed 41.40203,-93.09264.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): RA gives no Proximity to Water on any site. On NAIP the north loop (sites 070-078) is ~130 m from Lake Red Rock's shore through continuous forest on a bluff, and the other loops are further. RA photos of sites 058, 064, 072-075, 082 and 083 show lawn and trees with no water.

SEASON: the DNR alert of 10/15/2026 says the campground reopens 'February 28th 2027'; the stored manual season (from RA 'closed each year from December 1 - February 28') opens 03-01. One day apart; not changed.

Alerts: modern restrooms and showers closed from Oct 19, 2026 until mid-April 2027; the park phone lines were down per the 10/30/2026 alert (it gives a reservation number, '1-887-427-2757', that looks mistyped). Phone 641-842-6008 confirmed on the DNR page.
Non-electric fit: sites 079-087 have no posted length and are grass sites without pads (RA photos). They are categorised for RVs and trailers, so the $12/$16 base stands.
